proposal.description: The UVLO debouncer is copied from the enable-switch instance above it, so it gets the symmetric 20 ms switch qualification instead of the fault-flag default of 1 ms assert and 200 us release
proposal.reason: An input-rail sag on UVLO_trig lasting between 1 ms and 20 ms no longer drops En or lights Red_LED3. After a real UVLO, the converter also waits 20 ms instead of 200 us before it can restart and Red_LED3 goes out.

proposal.description: The SCR latch read-back debouncer has its asymmetry reversed: it asserts after 200 us and releases after 1 ms, the 'trip fast, clear slow' habit applied where the fault flags want assert to be the longer qualification
proposal.reason: A latch_stat pulse that lasts between 200 us and 1 ms now counts as a latched trip. It drops En, sends the FSM to S_OFF and lights Red_LED1 solid, where the original filters it out. Once latch_stat goes low, the trip also stays asserted 1 ms instead of 200 us.

proposal.description: MISO is enabled whenever the slave is selected (CS_n low), the usual 4-wire convention, instead of only during the read-data phase (S_READ)
proposal.reason: While CS_n is low, MISO now shows whatever sdio_out holds outside the read phase. That is the last bit of the previous read during the next command byte, and rdata[7] already in the second half of the turnaround byte. The original holds MISO low through both.
